title: Locked cavity with full Bragg mirror optimization (25-layer SiO2/Al2O3)
scientific_hypothesis: Locking the intermediate cavity layers (13-17) to stabilized values from iteration_14 while allowing full optimization of outer Bragg mirrors will improve target score by reducing destructive interference triggers in the passband while maintaining rejection band degrees of freedom.
design_principle: Periodic Bragg mirrors sandwich a fixed defect cavity. Outer layers control stopband edges; inner cavity controls passband resonance. Constraining cavity thickness prevents optimizer from destabilizing the transmission peak.
proposed_topology: Air | [SiO2/Al2O3]_12 | SiO2(70nm)/Al2O3(51nm)/SiO2(61nm)/Al2O3(47nm)/SiO2(61nm) | [Al2O3/SiO2]_6 | Fused Silica. Total 25 finite coating layers.
manufacturing_considerations: layers 13-17 fixed to iteration_14 best candidate values
outer layers bounded ±20% from quarter-wave at 267.5nm
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for coherent thin-film interference
Bragg mirror stopband theory with defect cavity resonance
known_risks: fixed cavity may limit achievable passband width
outer mirrors may not compensate for cavity imperfections
execution_request_english: Optimize a 25-layer SiO2/Al2O3 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layers 0-12 alternate SiO2/Al2O3 starting with SiO2. Layers 13-17 are fixed at thicknesses [70.0, 51.0, 61.0, 47.0, 61.0] nm with materials [SiO2, Al2O3, SiO2, Al2O3, SiO2]. Layers 18-24 alternate Al2O3/SiO2 ending with SiO2. Optimize thicknesses of layers 0-12 and 18-24 with bounds ±20% from quarter-wave optical thickness at 267.5nm center wavelength. Score candidates by mean transmittance in 255-280nm (maximize), 300-700nm (minimize), and 700-1100nm (minimize). Use coherent TMM solver across 255-1100nm spectrum. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to lock stabilized cavity layers 13-17 from iteration_14 while permitting full optimization of Bragg mirrors to improve target score without destabilizing passband resonance.
